DaysUntilFruitFalls.Desc: Each fruit falls this many days after it appears on the tree. 0 = the same morning. With Random Drops on, this is the minimum.
RandomDrops.Desc: Each fruit picks its own day to fall, between Days Until Fruit Falls and Max Days Until Fruit Falls.
MaxDaysUntilFruitFalls.Desc: Only with Random Drops. The latest a fruit can fall, in days after it appears.
DropAllInStorm.Desc: On a stormy (lightning) day every fruit tree drops all its fruit that morning.
FarmOnly.Desc: Only trees on the farm. Off = every location.
ShakePalmTrees.Desc: Shake down coconuts from palm trees every morning.
ShakeNormalTrees.Desc: Shake down seeds from other wild trees every morning.
